hero.title: The Desktop Client That Puts OpenClaw Within Reach
hero.subtitle: No registration, no data collection, fully local AI agent management software

clawmate.title: What is ClawMate
clawmate.desc: ClawMate is the desktop management client for OpenClaw (macOS / Windows). It transforms OpenClaw's complex command lines and config files into intuitive graphical operations:
clawmate.positioning: ClawMate is not another AI assistant — it is the control panel for OpenClaw.

install.title: One-Click Runtime
install.desc: Install / upgrade / uninstall the OpenClaw runtime with one click. No command line needed.

config.title: Visual Management
config.desc: Agents, models, skills, plugins, MCP servers — all managed visually.

messaging.title: Channel Configuration
messaging.desc: Feishu, Discord, Telegram, Slack, WeChat and 20+ channels, unified config.

chat.title: Real-time Chat
chat.desc: Built-in streaming output, thought chain display, tool call visualization, multi-session.

automation.title: Automation & Memory
automation.desc: Session management, scheduled tasks, memory system, sandbox config — all visual.

cross_platform.title: Cross-Platform
cross_platform.desc: Native support for macOS and Windows with a consistent experience.

openclaw.title: What is OpenClaw
openclaw.desc: OpenClaw is an open-source multi-channel AI agent gateway that runs on any OS as a resident background daemon, featuring:

channels.title: Multi-Channel
channels.desc: Discord, iMessage, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Feishu and 20+ channels

models.title: Multi-Model
models.desc: 30+ providers, supports local models (Ollama / LM Studio)

agents.title: Agent System
agents.desc: Multi-agent collaboration, context management, memory recall, session compression

extensions.title: Extensibility
extensions.desc: Skill marketplace (ClawHub), plugin system, MCP protocol

automation.title: Automation
automation.desc: Scheduled tasks, webhooks, event hooks, workflow orchestration

opensource.title: Open Source
opensource.desc: Core code is open source, self-auditable

relationship.title: ClawMate + OpenClaw
relationship.quote: OpenClaw is the engine. ClawMate is the steering wheel and dashboard.
relationship.desc: OpenClaw handles all underlying capabilities, while ClawMate presents them to users in a friendly way. Without OpenClaw, ClawMate cannot run independently; without ClawMate, OpenClaw can only be used via command line and config files.

points.websocket: ClawMate connects to the local OpenClaw Gateway via WebSocket
points.local: All data flows through the local Gateway — ClawMate is just the control plane and chat UI
points.config: OpenClaw's config files (~/.openclaw/) are fully under user control

comparison.title: How It Compares
comparison.subtitle: All three support: multi-model switching · MCP protocol · skill/plugin extensions · automation · multi-agent

data.label: Data Collection
data.clawmate: Zero collection, no data sent back

cloud.label: Cloud Dependency
cloud.clawmate: None, no official cloud service required

diff.label: Key Differentiator
diff.clawmate: Privacy-first, open-source auditable, full data control
diff.workbuddy: Enterprise security audit, IM remote control

scene.label: Use Case
scene.clawmate: Privacy-conscious individuals/teams running AI agents long-term

privacy.title: Your Data Stays on Your Computer
privacy.subtitle: ClawMate was designed with privacy as the first principle:

noregister.title: No Account Required
noregister.desc: Download, install, and use — no identity information collected

zero.title: Zero Data Collection
zero.desc: No usage data, chat logs, or configuration sent back over the network

local.title: Fully Local
local.desc: OpenClaw Gateway runs locally; all AI interactions happen via local processes

apikey.title: Self-Managed API Keys
apikey.desc: Your model API keys are encrypted and stored locally, fully under your control

audit.title: Open-Source Auditable
audit.desc: OpenClaw's core code is open source — audit the data flow yourself

nocloud.title: No Cloud Dependency
nocloud.desc: No ClawMate cloud service required for full functionality

privacy.note: The only network requests are when you actively call AI model provider APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) — sent directly from your computer to the provider, passing through no intermediate servers.

items.privacy: Privacy-conscious individuals/enterprises who don't want to hand conversations and data to cloud services
items.longterm: Anyone wanting a long-running personal AI agent across multiple IM channels
items.nogui: Users who want to use OpenClaw without wrestling with command lines and config files
items.automation: Teams that need AI agents to execute scheduled tasks and automated workflows
